title: Panda dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- panda body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='65' rx='22' ry='20' fill='#e8e8f0'/>
  <!-- belly highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='13' ry='12' fill='#f8f8ff'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='32' r='18' fill='#e8e8f0'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='34' cy='18' r='7' fill='#3a3a6a'/>
  <circle cx='66' cy='18' r='7' fill='#3a3a6a'/>
  <!-- ear inner -->
  <circle cx='34' cy='18' r='4' fill='#5a5a9a'/>
  <circle cx='66' cy='18' r='4' fill='#5a5a9a'/>
  <!-- eye patches -->
  <ellipse cx='41' cy='32' rx='8' ry='7' fill='#3a3a6a'/>
  <ellipse cx='59' cy='32' rx='8' ry='7' fill='#3a3a6a'/>
  <!-- eye patch shine -->
  <ellipse cx='41' cy='31' rx='6' ry='5' fill='#4a4a7a'/>
  <ellipse cx='59' cy='31' rx='6' ry='5' fill='#4a4a7a'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='41' cy='32' r='3' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='32' r='3' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='41' cy='32' r='1.5' fill='#1a1a3a'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='32' r='1.5' fill='#1a1a3a'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='39' rx='3' ry='2' fill='#3a3a6a'/>
  <!-- mouth -->
  <path d='M46 42 Q50 46 54 42' fill='none' stroke='#5a5a9a' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- arms raised dancing -->
  <path d='M30 55 Q18 40 24 28' fill='none' stroke='#3a3a6a' stroke-width='7' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M70 55 Q82 40 76 28' fill='none' stroke='#3a3a6a' stroke-width='7' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- arm tips/shine -->
  <circle cx='24' cy='28' r='4' fill='#5a5a9a'/>
  <circle cx='76' cy='28' r='4' fill='#5a5a9a'/>
  <!-- legs dancing -->
  <path d='M38 82 Q32 92 36 96' fill='none' stroke='#3a3a6a' stroke-width='7' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M62 82 Q70 90 68 96' fill='none' stroke='#3a3a6a' stroke-width='7' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- feet -->
  <ellipse cx='35' cy='96' rx='6' ry='3' fill='#5a5a9a'/>
  <ellipse cx='69' cy='96' rx='6' ry='3' fill='#5a5a9a'/>
  <!-- music notes -->
  <g fill='#ffe066'>
    <path d='M18 22 L18 12 L26 10 L26 20' fill='none' stroke='#ffe066' stroke-width='1.8'/>
    <circle cx='16' cy='22' r='3' fill='#ffe066'/>
    <circle cx='24' cy='20' r='3' fill='#ffe066'/>
    <path d='M80 20 L80 10 L88 8 L88 18' fill='none' stroke='#66ffcc' stroke-width='1.8'/>
    <circle cx='78' cy='20' r='3' fill='#66ffcc'/>
    <circle cx='86' cy='18' r='3' fill='#66ffcc'/>
  </g>
  <!-- sparkle -->
  <path d='M50 8 L51 12 L55 13 L51 14 L50 18 L49 14 L45 13 L49 12 Z' fill='#ffe066'/>
</svg>
